svg.title: Enterprise AI platform: end-to-end architecture
svg.desc: Users enter through chat, embedded copilots, collaboration, analytics, agent studio or APIs. Identity routes requests to an orchestrator with human review, domain agents and shared capability agents. Tool and model gateways connect to governed knowledge, data pipelines and systems of record. Evaluation and governance run alongside the request path. Eight numbered flows and seven security checkpoints connect these components. This is a proposed reference design.
svg.text: Technical users: analysts, data scientists, engineers
Identity, entitlements and intent router: user-delegated access, persona context
Domain agents support a business outcome; people remain accountable
Shared capability agents serve each domain within approved access
Registry, authZ, risk tier per tool
Ingest, contracts, quality, lineage, PII and intended-use tags
Security controls enforced at S1 to S7
Oversight forums decide policy, tiers, funding and required evidence
